name: Yearly ZCTA-Level Stratified Counts
description: Yearly ZCTA-level counts stratified by age group, sex, race, and dual eligibility.

content.year: Int64: Calendar year of the data
content.age_grp: String: Age group category of beneficiaries
content.sex: Int32: Sex of the beneficiary. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female.
content.race: Int32: SSA Beneficiary Race Code (Base). Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = White, 2 = Black, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = North American Native.
content.race_rti: Int32: RTI-assigned enhanced race classification. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Non-Hispanic White, 2 = Black or African-American, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian/Pacific Islander, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = American Indian/Alaska Native.
content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility status. Code values: 1 = dual eligible, 0 = not dual.
content.hmo: Int32: HMO enrollment status. Code values: 1 = enrolled in Medicare Advantage (HMO), 0 = not enrolled.
content.buyin: Int32: Buy-in status for Medicare A/B. Code values: 1 = any state buy-in months, 0 = none.
content.age_65plus_ind: Int32: Age 65 or older indicator. Code values: 1 = age 65 or older, 0 = under age 65.
content.disability_ind: Int32: Disability entitlement indicator. Code values: 1 = disability entitlement, 0 = no disability entitlement.
